title: Vela incident labeled the '747 incident'

tellings.quote:
>> It's it's called uh the seven they
labeled it as the 747 incident.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen is a former official of the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency. On Jesse Michels' podcast he talked about the Vela incident, an event in 1979 over the South Atlantic that is linked in his telling to South Africa and Israel. He says an unnamed scientist from the US Department of Energy told him that insiders labeled it "the 747 incident", a hint that it was handled under a different name from the public one.
